experiments.purpose: Determine which stdlib functions support typed throws (throws(E)) with generic E, and what annotations are needed.
experiments.statusDetail: stdlib partially supports typed throws; @_disfavoredOverload same-name overloads interfere with native throws(E) resolution.

experiments.purpose: Measure wall-clock build time, CPU-seconds, frontend-stats, and binary size across target-count N ∈ {1, 10, 40, max≈87} for swift-standard-library-extensions.
experiments.statusDetail: Endpoints measured post-relocation. N=1 debug clean: 1.54s median. N=79 strict (zero intra-deps, no Core, no special cases; format subsystem moved to swift-format-primitives) debug clean: 4.73s median. Ratio ~3.07× — mid-band of predicted 1.5-4×. 556/556 tests pass on swift-standard-library-extensions; 39/39 on swift-format-primitives. Incremental, release, and consumer scenarios deferred. See Outputs/report.md.
